# Managed files - generated by merging base + private overlay
# Format: base[+overlay]:destination
# base path relative to $DOTFILES_DIR, overlay relative to $PRIVATE_DIR
# JSON files merged with jq (deep merge), TOML/YAML files merged with yq (overlay wins;
# maps deep-merged, scalars overlay-wins)

configs/base/claude/settings.base.json+claude-settings.json:$HOME/.claude/settings.json
configs/base/claude/known_marketplaces.base.json+claude-plugins-marketplaces.json:$HOME/.claude/plugins/known_marketplaces.json
configs/base/claude/installed_plugins.base.json+claude-plugins-installed.json:$HOME/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json
configs/base/jj/.config/jj/config.toml+jj/config.toml:$HOME/.config/jj/config.toml
